decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offset intervals within allowed context [575,699] are identified based on original N/E/U samples: (1) a platform-like segment 620–635 with elevated N/E but inconclusive U behavior and missing data preventing return confirmation; (2) a broader elevated-variability interval 610–664 lacking coherent cross-axis onset/return structure. Neither meets confirmed status due to ambiguous return dynamics and absence of opposing trend on all axes. No other temporary offsets are supported.

intervals.observation: N/E elevated (~12–14) and relatively stable from ~620 to 635, while U fluctuates between -3 and -5; shape consistent with a platform-like temporary offset on N/E, but return not observed due to missing data at 636–641. U shows no clear sustained shift matching N/E, weakening confidence in full 3D offset.

Elevated variability persists through 664, but without coherent cross-axis morphology: N/E show intermittent spikes and drifts, U remains noisy without sustained deviation. No clear onset/return pair; ambiguous superposition of drift and noise. Return behavior obscured by gaps and lack of opposing trend.
